distanceRationale: Only the analytic scaffolding of the base case exists: Mathlib has the Dedekind zeta L-series (no continuation to s = -1) and zeta(-1) = -1/12 via Bernoulli numbers, but neither library has K_2 of rings of integers, Tate's K_2/Galois-cohomology comparison, Iwasawa modules or main conjectures. The headline all-prime theorem for every totally real field combines Wiles's main conjecture with Kurihara's 2025 theorem and a Kurihara-to-Kolster comparison that the roadmap itself says is still to be proved, on top of the ArithmeticKTheory and IntegralIwasawaTheory programmes (both 9).

distanceRationale: Tau Ceti has made a real start on the lowest analytic layers: Fredholm operators and index stability, finite-dimensional Morse-Sard, Sard-Smale, the Morse lemma and index, gradient flows, and definitions of almost complex structures and pseudoholomorphic maps. Every headline object is still missing, and so is every layer under it: stable manifolds and Morse-Smale transversality, trajectory compactness and gluing, the Cauchy-Riemann elliptic package and spectral-flow index theorem, Gromov compactness, J-curve transversality and gluing, Lagrangian Floer homology, and Sym^g geometry with Heegaard diagrams and spin^c structures.
mathlibEvidence: tauceti:TauCeti.isMeagre_image_criticalPoints_of_isFredholm (TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/SardSmale.lean) — the Sard-Smale theorem for Fredholm maps, built on Mathlib's ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm with Tau Ceti's index stability (Fredholm/SmallPerturbation.lean, CompactPerturbation.lean) and finite-dimensional Morse-Sard (Analysis/Calculus/Sard/); no Fredholm theory of Cauchy-Riemann operators on strips, spectral flow or Riemann-Roch with boundary

tauceti:TauCeti.IsNondegenerateCriticalPoint.exists_morse_chart (TauCeti/Analysis/Calculus/Morse/NormalForm.lean) — the Morse(-Palais) lemma, with Morse index, negative gradient flows, stable/unstable sets and genericity of Morse functions in Analysis/Calculus/Morse/; no stable-manifold theorem, Morse-Smale transversality, broken-trajectory compactness, gluing, Morse complex or comparison with singular homology

tauceti:TauCeti.IsPseudoholomorphicAt (TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/Manifold/JHolomorphic.lean) — the nonlinear Cauchy-Riemann equation between almost complex manifolds, alongside symplectic, totally real and Lagrangian linear algebra and a pointwise energy identity (Geometry/Symplectic/); no elliptic regularity, Gromov compactness, transversality or gluing for J-holomorphic strips

absent: Calderon-Zygmund estimates, Maslov index of Lagrangian paths and spectral flow, Gromov compactness, Lagrangian Floer homology, symmetric products Sym^g of surfaces, Heegaard diagrams, 3-manifold spin^c structures, HF-hat (no declarations matching CalderonZygmund|spectralFlow|FloerHomology|FloerComplex|MorseSmale|MorseComplex|Heegaard|removableSingular; Maslov only as grid gradings, Gromov only Gromov-Hausdorff, spinc only Lie-theoretic spin carriers)
